    • keyName

      public CreateKeyRequest.CreateKeyRequestBuilder keyName(String keyName)
      Optional human-readable name of the key, unique within the client's key container. Providers that assign their own key ids register it as an alias of the key; providers that require caller-chosen key ids use it as the id, and for those it is required.

      public CreateKeyRequest.CreateKeyRequestBuilder policy(KeyPolicy policy)
      Optional access policy for the new key. Providers that accept a policy at creation apply it atomically; the others apply it immediately after creating the key. When unset the provider's default policy applies.
      Returns:
      this.
